confidence_notes: Rarotonga's recent aggregate prices give a useful but thin basis for meals, cappuccino and draft beer. Cocktail and restaurant wine-glass prices are not directly observed here and are estimated from the local beer price relationship. Accommodation estimates are holistic; the limited city-specific basis and uncertain hostel supply make them especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Avarua is on Rarotonga, so Rarotonga is the closest same-island cost reference. Island remoteness and tourism support higher room costs than a comparable mainland town; lodging values remain broad model estimates.
